description: Connect your Antevo Wealth account and ask about your own book in plain language: today's brief for your household, what your positions and allocation look like, total assets under management, drift against your model, correlations and concentration, real assets beyond listed securities, open compliance breaches and unread alerts, and what is on your calendar. Every answer is dated and names the source it came from. You need an Antevo Wealth account to sign in - this connector reads your own data and nothing else, and anything that would change a record describes the change and waits for your approval first.
